source.listing_description:
High-performance Intel Xeon E5-2680 V4 processor features 14 cores at 2.4GHz providing efficient multitasking and server-grade computing power.

This CPU addresses demanding data processing and virtualization needs by delivering reliable, multi-threaded performance with a 120W thermal design power for balanced energy use.

Key Features

  • 14 Cores / 28 Threads: Handles multitasking and parallel workloads for servers and workstations.
  • Base Clock 2.4GHz: Consistent processing speed for balanced performance and energy efficiency.
  • LGA 2011-3 Socket: Compatible with select motherboards supporting Intel Broadwell architecture.
  • 120W TDP: Optimized thermal design for stable operation under load.

Specifications

  • Model: Intel Xeon E5-2680 V4
  • CPU Socket: LGA 2011-3 (Socket R3)
  • Core Count: 14 cores / 28 threads
  • Base Frequency: 2.4GHz
  • Thermal Design Power (TDP): 120 Watts
  • Weight: Approx. 45g / 1.59oz
  • Dimensions: 5.25cm x 5.25cm / 2.07in x 2.07in (typical processor size)
